name: Hoh River
gaugeName: Hoh River at US Highway 101 near Forks
blurb: Milky glacial river out of the Hoh Rain Forest in Olympic National Park.

sections.notes: Long run with log jams (NPS rates it Class II–III with log jams). Morgan's Crossing (~mile 12.7) is an intermediate access. Put-in is inside Olympic National Park: entrance pass required ($30 per private vehicle, 7 days; cashless). Oxbow take-out manager and pass not confirmed.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
